subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

It is no exaggeration to say the Hussain Sagar Lake is an __integral__ element of Hyderabad and Hyderabad’s history.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **extra**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"integral"** means something that is essential or necessary for completeness. (अभिन्न)

 
 
• **Example: **An engine is an integral part of a car.
 
 
 
• **"Extra"** refers to something that is additional or not necessary. (अतिरिक्त)
 
 
• **Example: **She added some extra toppings to her pizza.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'integral'** is **'extra'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **extra**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Essential **(आवश्यक): Absolutely necessary or extremely important.

 
 
• **Example:** Water is essential for life.
 
 
 
• **Total **(कुल): Comprising the whole number or amount.
 
 
• **Example: **The total cost of the project was $5000.
 
 
 
• **Inherent** (अंतर्निहित): Existing in something as a permanent, essential, or characteristic attribute.
 
 
• **Example:** The inherent risks of skydiving are well-known.
